verse.verse_1: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe, and Who has power over everything;
verse.verse_2: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving;
verse.verse_3: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One's creation. Turn your vision again, can you see any flaw?
verse.verse_4: Then turn your vision again, and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you, worn out and frustrated.
verse.verse_5: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_6: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!
verse.verse_7: When they will be cast into it, they will hear it roar as it boils,
verse.verse_8: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it, its keepers will ask them: “Did no warner come to you?”
verse.verse_9: They will say: “Yes, a warner came to us, but we gave the lie to him and said: 'Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.'
verse.verse_10: They will say: 'If we had only listened and understood, we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.'”
verse.verse_11: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_12: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.
verse.verse_13: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud, (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.
verse.verse_14: Would He not know, He Who has created, when He is All-Subtle, All-Aware?
verse.verse_15: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.
verse.verse_16: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you, and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?
verse.verse_17: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!
verse.verse_18: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!
verse.verse_19: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings, with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.
verse.verse_20: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.
verse.verse_21: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.
verse.verse_22: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face, or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?
verse.verse_23: Say: “He it is Who has brought you into being, and has given you hearing and sight, and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!”
verse.verse_24: Say: “Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.”
verse.verse_25: They say: “If you are truthful, tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?”
verse.verse_26: Say: “Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.”
verse.verse_27: When they will see it near at hand, the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught, and then they will be told: “This is the doom which you used to ask for.”
verse.verse_28: Say to them: “Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me, or shows mercy to us, who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?”
verse.verse_29: Say to them: “He is Merciful, and it is in Him that we believe, and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.”
verse.verse_30: Say to them: “Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth, who will produce for you clear, flowing water?”
